description: One owner per custom path against the explicitly pinned upstream baseline. Current-main tree distance and graph backlog are reported separately, never presented as custom patch weight.

groups.title: CPU shared-memory allocator
groups.handling: Adds the SHM allocator type and memfd/mmap-backed buffers with data-pointer access.
groups.rationale: Needed for sessionless and nested CPU rendering. Review format/stride/size bounds, failed allocation cleanup and buffer lifetime; converge when upstream supplies an equivalent allocator.

groups.title: Nested Wayland without dmabuf
groups.handling: Submits SHM buffers using wl_shm pools, handles missing dmabuf, advertises baseline formats and preserves an early configured output size.
groups.rationale: Hosts such as software-rendered Sway may provide no dmabuf. Split generic host compatibility fixes from allocator integration, then test configure timing, frame scheduling, buffer release and cursor paths.

groups.title: CPU allocator selection and DRM scanout
groups.handling: Selects AQ_FORCE_ALLOCATOR=shm/dumb, opens the primary node for dumb buffers, falls back to SHM without a DRM fd and skips the GL renderer for CPU allocators.
groups.rationale: The Mac needs KMS scanout without EGL/GBM rendering. Validate primary-node ownership, scanout/cursors, suspend/resume and unforced GBM behavior; keep until upstream has equivalent support.

groups.title: Fork documentation and divergence tooling
groups.handling: Owns only fork documentation, accounting code, and its CI. Kept separate from runtime patch totals.
groups.rationale: Reviewable accounting should not masquerade as renderer code. Keep the reporter aligned with Omarchy's implementation.
